title: Paying the Statement Minimum through the Crestline Care Desk — Crestline Credit Card
content:
When a cardholder pays the minimum payment of the latest Crestline Credit Card statement through the care desk, the desk works out that minimum on the day the payment is taken, from the ledger as it then stands.

**When the minimum is settled.** The minimum payment the desk takes on a statement is not fixed until every late fee posted in that statement's cycle that meets the courtesy credit conditions carries its courtesy credit.

Restated in the same terms: a late fee of the statement's cycle that meets the courtesy credit conditions and does not yet carry its courtesy credit on the card ledger leaves the minimum the desk takes on that statement unsettled; once every such fee carries its courtesy credit, the minimum is settled from the ledger as it then stands.

## Printed minimum and the minimum taken at the desk

On every statement the printed minimum payment is the larger of the product's payment floor and the product's percentage of the new balance excluding equal-payment plan balances, rounded up to the whole dollar, plus every amount the product adds on top of it (the fixed monthly payment of each equal-payment plan, any past-due amount and a late fee posted in the cycle); when the new balance is below the payment floor the printed minimum is the whole new balance; while a billing-error dispute is open the disputed amount is left out of the printed minimum when the product so provides. The minimum payment the desk takes on the latest statement, and only that payment, is figured on the day it is taken under the desk schedule, except that on an account carrying a 36-month or 48-month equal-payment plan, or more than one 24-month plan, the desk takes the minimum printed on the statement less the payments made toward that statement since it closed.

## Taking the payment: `pay_statement_minimum_b2a1a039`

**Capability.** The cardholder pays toward one statement of their own Crestline Credit Card account through the automated phone payment line, from the bank account they keep on file. One call records one payment on the account ledger, dated today, through the phone channel, tied to the statement it is made toward and carrying a new payment confirmation number; it writes only that entry and changes no other record (the account record's stored balance field is not updated).

**How it is invoked.** This is the cardholder's own tool: the agent unlocks `pay_statement_minimum_b2a1a039` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `card_account_id` | reference number of the cardholder's Crestline Credit Card account, read from the card account lookup | identifier text |
| `statement_date` | closing date of the statement the payment is made toward, exactly as that statement shows it | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `amount` | the amount paid | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; kept rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` (always "received" on success), `payment_reference` (the confirmation number, PMT- followed by 9 digits), `card_txn_id` (reference of the new payment entry), `card_account_id`, `statement_date`, `amount` (USD, 2 decimals), `payment_channel` (always "phone") and `txn_date` (posting date, YYYY-MM-DD). The call succeeds whenever the account, the statement and the amount are supplied; the tool itself checks no condition and computes no figure.
